title.en: Curved raised platform reaching into the pool

alt.tr: Çimenden havuza doğru uzanan, kavisli kenarlı ve yükseltilmiş açık renkli ahşap platform; ortada şemsiye direği
alt.en: Raised pale timber platform with curved edges reaching from the lawn towards the pool, with a parasol post in the middle

caption.tr: Platform ayaklar üzerinde duruyor, yan yüzeyleri kavisli tahtalarla kapatılmış. Dar bir deck geçidi platformu havuz kenarına bağlıyor.
caption.en: The platform stands on legs with its sides closed by curved boards. A narrow deck walkway links it to the pool edge.
